Two Youths Found Dead, Families Allege Murder in Separate Incidents

Two separate incidents of young men being found dead have been reported in India. In Warangal, Telangana, a youth was discovered murdered in Urs Gutta. In Jalandhar, a youth was found dead, with his family alleging foul play. Both cases are under investigation.
